name: Beauty Pie
description: British membership beauty club founded in 2016 by Marcia Kilgore, selling own-label skincare, makeup and body care at members' prices through beautypie.com.

evidence.summary: Beauty Pie's Awin merchant profile (ID 12780, read first-hand) lists its affiliate program at 6% CPA on new members and 0.5% CPA on existing members with a 30-day cookie; the program is managed by Good Kind Digital.
The Awin profile names the program's management contact at Good Kind Digital (kelly@goodkinddigital.com).
Beauty Pie is a membership beauty club founded in 2016 by Marcia Kilgore, selling skincare, makeup and body products direct to consumers.

reasons.niche_fit: Pure skincare and makeup brand with a strong creator following — squarely in the beauty niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Runs an open network affiliate program on Awin that beauty creators routinely promote; no separate brand-run creator community is published.
reasons.compensation: Awin lists 6% CPA on new members but only 0.5% CPA on existing members, so effective earnings depend heavily on new-member mix.
reasons.contact_access: A named program-management email (Good Kind Digital) is published on the Awin merchant profile.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Awin, subject to network approval.
reasons.credibility: Established brand founded in 2016 by serial beauty founder Marcia Kilgore, with its own e-commerce operation.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application on the brand's own affiliate page.
reasons.credibility: Established brand built on the large Wellness Mama audience, selling through its own store.

name: SNOW
description: US oral-beauty brand selling LED teeth-whitening kits, whitening toothpaste and related products direct to consumers at trysnow.com.

evidence.summary: Lasso's program page (read first-hand) routes SNOW affiliate sign-ups to ShareASale, confirming an affiliate program on that network; Lasso quotes 15%.

Published rates conflict — Lasso quotes 15%, another network listing quotes 10-20% on ShareASale with a 30-day cookie, Shopper quotes 5-10%, and the program has also been reported on Everflow — so no single rate could be verified and the rate is recorded as null.

SNOW is a heavily creator-promoted teeth-whitening brand; its founder's public content cites roughly 20% creator commissions and up to 30% through TikTok Shop, figures that could not be reconciled with the network listings.

reasons.niche_fit: Teeth whitening is a staple before/after beauty-creator category, especially on TikTok.
reasons.ugc_evidence: One of the most heavily creator-promoted oral-beauty brands, with an open network program and TikTok Shop presence.
reasons.compensation: Listings conflict widely (5-10% up to 15-20%, plus separate TikTok Shop figures), so no rate is verified; scored low until confirmed.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through ShareASale; no public partnerships email could be verified from a fetched page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through ShareASale, subject to network approval.
reasons.credibility: Well-known DTC oral-beauty brand with mass retail distribution.

name: Suu Balm
description: Singapore skincare brand from Good Pharma Dermatology, selling menthol-based creams, washes and scalp care for dry, itchy, sensitive and eczema-prone skin.

evidence.summary: Suu Balm's own Ambassador Programme agreement (read first-hand on its UpPromote registration page) pays a 10% commission on total cart-out value (after discounts, excluding shipping) with a 14-day cookie, paid monthly to PayPal in SGD; the agreement names info@suubalm.com for program questions.

The brand actively recruits creators for the programme, including TikTok affiliates in Malaysia, where its social posts advertise tiered commissions of up to 18% through TikTok — a separate channel from the 10% DTC ambassador terms.
Suu Balm is the consumer skincare brand of Singapore's Good Pharma Dermatology Pte. Ltd., focused on dry, itchy and eczema-prone skin.

reasons.niche_fit: Sensitive-skin and eczema care is a focused, high-intent skincare niche with strong problem/solution content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs its own ambassador programme and actively recruits TikTok creators with samples and monthly campaigns.
reasons.compensation: Its own programme agreement states 10% on cart-out value with a 14-day cookie and monthly PayPal payout; TikTok channel tiers advertise up to 18% separately.
reasons.contact_access: The programme agreement itself publishes a contact email (info@suubalm.com) plus an open registration page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open registration on the brand's own programme page.
reasons.credibility: Established Singapore dermocosmetic brand (Good Pharma Dermatology) sold across Southeast Asia.
